summary: Iteration 40: Verified the N+1 optimization (bulk GET /api/workers/account-statuses) end-to-end. Backend: 9 new tests (auth/RBAC, response shape, Marija correctness, bulk-vs-individual consistency, route-ordering, create/reset/delete lifecycle) all pass; regression suites test_rbac_worker.py (12), test_reset_password.py (3), test_must_change_password.py (6) all pass. Frontend: admin login -> Radnici loads with EXACTLY ONE bulk call and ZERO per-worker /account calls (N+1 eliminated); Marija shows 'Nalog aktivan (worker@salon.com)' with green dot; 6 account-less workers show 'Kreiraj nalog za prijavu'; Resetuj lozinku, Kreiraj nalog (temp password panel), Ukloni nalog and Dodaj Radnika dialogs all work; worker login + read-only 'Moj Raspored' CalendarView works with restricted nav. No blocking issues in the optimization itself. Found one pre-existing security/UX gap: worker can render the admin Radnici page via direct URL, and SalonWorkers swallows the 403 silently.

minor.issue: No brute-force protection / account lockout. 6 consecutive failed logins for the same email all return 401 with no 429 or lockout (playbook item 4 not implemented).

allow_origins=[FRONTEND_URL, "*"] with allow_credentials=True. Response echoes access-control-allow-origin: * plus allow-credentials: true, which browsers reject for credentialed (cookie) requests. Should use explicit origins only.
Cookies set with secure=False (edge currently upgrades to Secure); should be driven by env/config for production correctness.

No idempotent seed_admin/seed_worker script exists in backend or scripts. Seeded test accounts live only in Mongo, so an accidental 'Ukloni nalog' permanently destroys the documented worker@salon.com credential (this happened during testing and had to be manually restored).

ui_bugs.issue: Missing role guard: a logged-in worker who navigates directly to /:slug/admin/employees gets the full admin Radnici UI rendered (Dodaj Radnika, edit/delete worker, Kreiraj nalog links). Backend correctly returns 403 (data safe, mutations blocked) but the admin surface should not render for role=worker.
'Ukloni nalog' deletes a worker's login account immediately with no confirmation dialog (unlike worker deletion which has DeleteWorkerDialog). One misclick permanently destroys credentials.

integration_issues.issue: Empty catch: `catch { setWorkerAccounts({}) }` (SalonWorkers.jsx:61) silently swallows 401/403/500/network failures and renders every worker as having no account ('Kreiraj nalog za prijavu'), which is misleading. Reproduced with worker role: Marija showed 'Kreiraj nalog za prijavu' while the bulk call was 403. Should surface an error state instead of a false-negative.

fetchData runs twice on mount (2x /workers?active_only=false and 2x /workers/account-statuses observed). Consistent with React StrictMode double-invoke in dev, but worth confirming there is no missing effect guard.

action_items: Add role-based route guard so role=worker cannot render admin routes (/employees, /services, /settings, /blacklist) via direct URL.
Replace the empty catch in SalonWorkers.jsx:61 with an error state/toast so a failed account-statuses call is not rendered as 'no accounts'.
Add a confirmation dialog before 'Ukloni nalog' (delete worker account).
Add brute-force lockout (e.g. 5 failed attempts -> 429/temporary lock) on /api/auth/login.
Fix CORS: drop the '*' entry from allow_origins while allow_credentials=True.
Add an idempotent seed script for admin@salon.com / worker@salon.com so seeded test credentials can be restored.
critical_code_review_comments: worker_routes.py:43 - static route /workers/account-statuses is declared before parameterized worker routes; verified no shadowing. Good.
worker_routes.py:53-56 - projection excludes _id, so no ObjectId leaks; single find() call confirms N+1 removal. Good.
worker_routes.py:49-51 - check_tenant_access applied for non-super_admin; RBAC verified 403 for worker, 401 for missing/invalid token.
worker_routes.py:222 - individual GET /workers/{id}/account kept for back-compat but no longer used by the frontend; consider removing once no consumers remain.
SalonWorkers.jsx is 354 lines and fine, but the bare `catch {}` blocks hide integration failures - anti-pattern for the required loading/success/error states.
seed_data_creation: Temp worker 'TEST_BulkStatusWorker' + test_bulkstatus@salon.com account created and deleted within tests. UI test created/deleted test_milena_qa@salon.com for Milena (cleaned up). Verified login 200 and 'Nalog aktivan (worker@salon.com)' visible in UI.

New regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_worker_account_statuses.py (9 tests, all pass). test_reset_password.py was fixed to load /app/backend/.env (it failed standalone with 'name must be an instance of str' because DB_NAME was unset). Open items for retest after fixes: worker role guard on admin routes, error state instead of empty catch in SalonWorkers.jsx, confirm dialog on Ukloni nalog.
rca_of_the_issue: No defect in the N+1 change itself. Two pre-existing weaknesses were exposed by it: (1) AdminDashboard renders admin child routes purely by URL with no role check, so a worker sees the Radnici admin UI; (2) SalonWorkers.jsx wraps the bulk account-statuses call in a bare catch that resets state to {} on any failure, so a 403/500 is indistinguishable from 'no worker has an account' - the worker-role view rendered 'Kreiraj nalog za prijavu' for Marija despite her having an active account.
